description: [1, "a", true] is runtime-safe real Ruby (Ruby arrays are heterogeneous). Ty.arrayOf requires one element type structurally, but Ty.any already exists for exactly this -- a claim of arrayOf(Ty.any) on the array node is expressible today. No language gap; a rebuilt `array` rule should accept an element type via subTy (which admits `any`), not raw equality, or fall back to a claim.
